entries.title: 多窗口售票与停车位管理
entries.questionHtml: 停车场类(生产者消费者) — 编写停车场 Java 类（入库/出库，生产者消费者模式）（美团）
entries.analysisHtml: 票号1..N，N=0立即售罄；多窗口共享同一Tickets，sell无票/取消返回空，cancel停止后续售票而不撤销已售票。停车tryEnter满位拒绝，enter提供可中断限时等待；同一活动车牌重复进入视为幂等成功，重复exit不再增加空位。close拒绝新准入，已有车辆仍能离开。车牌要求非null；实际识别可信性由调用方负责。
entries.answerHtml:
多窗口售票与停车场容量：两个独立小型 Java 合同

先说清题目约定

票号1..N，N=0立即售罄；多窗口共享同一Tickets，sell无票/取消返回空，cancel停止后续售票而不撤销已售票。停车tryEnter满位拒绝，enter提供可中断限时等待；同一活动车牌重复进入视为幂等成功，重复exit不再增加空位。close拒绝新准入，已有车辆仍能离开。车牌要求非null；实际识别可信性由调用方负责。

为什么这样写是正确的

票号检查与递增在一个monitor内；停车集合检查、添加、删除也在一个monitor内。占位量直接来自集合size，避免集合与额外Semaphore计数失配。exit只有实际删除成功才唤醒，等待者循环检查满位条件并扣减单个总预算。

时间和空间成本

售票O(1)、O(1)状态；停车HashSet期望O(1)查询/修改、O(capacity)状态，哈希冲突有最坏退化。

怎样验证边界

8窗口同起跑售出1000个唯一票号，验证零库存和取消；100辆竞争3位不超限，重复进/出、满位超时、离开唤醒等待及关闭排空。

哪些条件需要另行处理

不是铁路区间票务系统，也不是原停车场数据库/设备流程实现。取消只影响未来sell；synchronized的争锁本身不可中断，临界区刻意有限且不做I/O。

TicketParking.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

/** 两个独立建模：票号不可回收；停车用活动车辆集合，防止重复出场多还许可。 */
public final class TicketParking {
    public static final class Tickets {
        private final int total;private int next=1;private boolean closed;
        public Tickets(int total){if(total<0 || total==Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new IllegalArgumentException();this.total=total;}
        public synchronized OptionalInt sell(){if(closed || next>total)return OptionalInt.empty();return OptionalInt.of(next++);}
        public synchronized void cancel(){closed=true;}
    }
    public static final class Parking {
        private final int capacity;private final Set<String> parked=new HashSet<>();private boolean closed;
        public Parking(int capacity){if(capacity<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();this.capacity=capacity;}
        /** 原题未指定满位行为：提供即时拒绝及可中断限时等待两个明确 API。 */
        public synchronized boolean tryEnter(String plate){Objects.requireNonNull(plate);if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("closed");if(parked.contains(plate))return true;if(parked.size()==capacity)return false;parked.add(plate);return true;}
        public synchronized boolean enter(String plate,long timeout,TimeUnit unit)throws InterruptedException{
            Objects.requireNonNull(plate);if(timeout<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();long budget=unit.toNanos(timeout),start=System.nanoTime();
            while(!closed && !parked.contains(plate) && parked.size()==capacity){long left=budget-(System.nanoTime()-start);if(left<=0)return false;TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.timedWait(this,left);}
            return tryEnter(plate);
        }
        public synchronized boolean exit(String plate){Objects.requireNonNull(plate);boolean removed=parked.remove(plate);if(removed)notifyAll();return removed;}
        public synchronized int occupancy(){return parked.size();}
        public synchronized void close(){closed=true;notifyAll();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        Tickets tickets=new Tickets(1000);Set<Integer> sold=ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);CountDownLatch go=new CountDownLatch(1);
        try{
            List<Future<?>>fs=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<8;i++)fs.add(p.submit(()->{go.await();for(;;){OptionalInt n=tickets.sell();if(n.isEmpty())break;if(!sold.add(n.getAsInt()))throw new AssertionError("duplicate");}return null;}));go.countDown();for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(sold.size()!=1000 || !sold.contains(1) || !sold.contains(1000))throw new AssertionError("oversell");
            if(new Tickets(0).sell().isPresent())throw new AssertionError();Tickets cancelled=new Tickets(2);cancelled.cancel();if(cancelled.sell().isPresent())throw new AssertionError();
            Parking park=new Parking(3);fs.clear();AtomicInteger admitted=new AtomicInteger();
            for(int i=0;i<100;i++){String plate="p"+i;fs.add(p.submit(()->{if(park.tryEnter(plate))admitted.incrementAndGet();}));}for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(admitted.get()!=3 || park.occupancy()!=3)throw new AssertionError("capacity");
            Parking one=new Parking(1);if(!one.tryEnter("a") || !one.tryEnter("a") || one.tryEnter("b"))throw new AssertionError();
            if(!one.exit("a") || one.exit("a") || one.occupancy()!=0)throw new AssertionError("duplicate exit");
            one.tryEnter("b");if(one.enter("c",10,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))throw new AssertionError("timeout");
            Future<Boolean> waiter=p.submit(()->one.enter("c",2,TimeUnit.SECONDS));one.exit("b");if(!waiter.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("producer consumer wake");
            one.close();if(!one.exit("c"))throw new AssertionError("drain exit");
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("TicketParking PASS: 1000 unique sales, zero/cancel, capacity3, duplicate enter/exit, timed wait, close");
    }
}

entries.title: 可退出的三线程死锁诊断
entries.questionHtml: 手写死锁 — 手撕：三个线程造成死锁（美团）
entries.analysisHtml: 仅作诊断实验；三方先拿到各自第一把锁，再由CountDownLatch屏障同时继续。第二把锁用lockInterruptibly。主线程最多等待3秒检测，再统一interrupt和有界join。线程为daemon是兜底，不是正常清理方式。
entries.answerHtml:
三线程三锁环：确定性复现、确证、可中断恢复

先说清题目约定

仅作诊断实验；三方先拿到各自第一把锁，再由CountDownLatch屏障同时继续。第二把锁用lockInterruptibly。主线程最多等待3秒检测，再统一interrupt和有界join。线程为daemon是兜底，不是正常清理方式。

为什么这样写是正确的

ThreadMXBean.findDeadlockedThreads必须包含全部三个指定threadId；进一步检查每个ThreadInfo的lockOwnerId是环中下一线程，避免误把其他死锁当成功。所有已获得的锁在finally中释放；中断不能自动解开synchronized死锁，所以此处有意选择可中断锁。

时间和空间成本

固定3线程/3锁O(1)状态，检测成本由JVM线程快照决定；不承诺真实生产故障都能靠中断恢复。

怎样验证边界

检测确切三方持有/等待环，打断后全部线程退出且全部锁释放；失败也在finally中统一收尾，进程外再有20秒上限。

哪些条件需要另行处理

没有启动不可恢复的真实monitor死锁；未执行或伪造jstack/jcmd现场输出。

ThreeThreadDeadlock.java · 完整源码

import java.lang.management.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;

/** 教学专用：三线程三锁环；用可中断锁恢复，不创建无法停止的 monitor 死锁。 */
public final class ThreeThreadDeadlock {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ReentrantLock[] locks = {new ReentrantLock(),new ReentrantLock(),new ReentrantLock()};
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3); Thread[] ts = new Thread[3];
        for(int i=0;i<3;i++) { final int role=i; ts[i]=new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                locks[role].lockInterruptibly();
                try { ready.countDown(); ready.await(); locks[(role+1)%3].lockInterruptibly();
                    try { } finally { locks[(role+1)%3].unlock(); }
                } finally { locks[role].unlock(); }
            } catch(InterruptedException expected) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
        }, "three-cycle-"+i); ts[i].setDaemon(true); }
        boolean found=false;
        try {
            for(Thread t:ts)t.start();
            if(!ready.await(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new AssertionError("first locks not acquired");
            ThreadMXBean mx=ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean();
            long start=System.nanoTime();
            while(System.nanoTime()-start<TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(3)) {
                long[] ids=mx.findDeadlockedThreads();
                if(ids!=null) {
                    Set<Long> dead=new HashSet<>();for(long id:ids)dead.add(id);
                    found=Arrays.stream(ts).allMatch(t->dead.contains(t.threadId()));
                    if(found) {
                        // 确认拥有者确实是指定环的下一人，而非偶然发现另一组死锁。
                        ThreadInfo[] info=mx.getThreadInfo(Arrays.stream(ts).mapToLong(Thread::threadId).toArray());
                        for(int i=0;i<3;i++) if(info[i].getLockOwnerId()!=ts[(i+1)%3].threadId())throw new AssertionError("wrong cycle");
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Thread.sleep(5);
            }
        } finally { for(Thread t:ts)t.interrupt(); for(Thread t:ts)t.join(2000); }
        if(!found || Arrays.stream(ts).anyMatch(Thread::isAlive))throw new AssertionError("detection/recovery failed");
        for(ReentrantLock l:locks)if(l.isLocked())throw new AssertionError("lock leaked");
        System.out.println("ThreeThreadDeadlock PASS: exact three-owner cycle, interrupted, all joined, all locks released");
    }
}

entries.title: 带版本与幂等收据的状态机
entries.questionHtml: 手写有限状态机(FST)管理Agent状态 — 实现一个有限状态机（FST）来管理Agent的状态。如果状态数量扩展到50个，FST怎么维护？会不会爆炸？如果状态之间有并发跳转怎么处理？（百度）
entries.analysisHtml: 转移表不可变；事件id在本实例内唯一，同id同event返回原收据，同id不同event拒绝；新事件需expectedVersion匹配，过期返回empty，非法边抛异常。一个不可变Data同时保存state/version/幂等历史/outbox，CAS整体发布，版本溢出拒绝。
entries.answerHtml:
50 状态稀疏迁移引擎：同版本竞争、事件去重与 outbox

先说清题目约定

转移表不可变；事件id在本实例内唯一，同id同event返回原收据，同id不同event拒绝；新事件需expectedVersion匹配，过期返回empty，非法边抛异常。一个不可变Data同时保存state/version/幂等历史/outbox，CAS整体发布，版本溢出拒绝。

为什么这样写是正确的

同版本两个不同事件最多一个迁移成功，失败者重读时发现版本变化；CAS成功是迁移和事件入outbox的共同线性化点。ack仅删除已确认待发项，不改变业务版本且与迁移CAS协调。发送失败不ack；发送成功而ack前崩溃会重发，下游必须按事件id幂等。这是内存原子性，非持久事务或跨系统exactly-once。

时间和空间成本

图存储O(V+E)，查边期望O(1)；本教学实现复制历史与outbox，每次迁移O(h+q)，累计历史无界。生产需要持久唯一收据、事务outbox、保留期、版本迁移和真实领域guard，不能宣称所有操作O(1)。

怎样验证边界

非法边、同版本两线程仅一成功、重复id不重迁移、payload冲突、发送重试去重/ack，完整走过50状态到终态并拒绝越界迁移。

哪些条件需要另行处理

真实Agent副作用、审批规则、持久化、跨进程竞争、重启恢复和旧machineVersion迁移未实现；接入业务前需要逐项确认这些约束。

WorkflowFsm.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

/** 自包含单工作流参考引擎；状态/版本/幂等收据/待发事件一次 CAS。不是某个未知仓库的修复。 */
public final class WorkflowFsm {
    public record Edge(String state,String event){}
    public record Receipt(String id,String event,String from,String to,long version){}
    private record Data(String state,long version,Map<String,Receipt> receipts,List<Receipt> outbox){}
    private final Map<Edge,String> graph;private final AtomicReference<Data> current;
    public WorkflowFsm(String initial,Map<Edge,String> transitions){graph=Map.copyOf(transitions);current=new AtomicReference<>(new Data(Objects.requireNonNull(initial),0,Map.of(),List.of()));}
    public String state(){return current.get().state();}public long version(){return current.get().version();}
    public List<Receipt> outbox(){return current.get().outbox();}
    /** 过期版本返回 empty；非法边拒绝；同 id 同 event 返回原收据，不重复迁移。 */
    public Optional<Receipt> apply(long expectedVersion,String id,String event){
        Objects.requireNonNull(id);Objects.requireNonNull(event);if(id.isBlank() || event.isBlank())throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        for(;;){Data old=current.get();Receipt previous=old.receipts().get(id);
            if(previous!=null){if(!previous.event().equals(event))throw new IllegalArgumentException("id reused with different event");return Optional.of(previous);}
            if(old.version()!=expectedVersion)return Optional.empty();String next=graph.get(new Edge(old.state(),event));
            if(next==null)throw new IllegalStateException("illegal transition");
            Receipt receipt=new Receipt(id,event,old.state(),next,Math.incrementExact(old.version()));
            Map<String,Receipt> history=new HashMap<>(old.receipts());history.put(id,receipt);List<Receipt> out=new ArrayList<>(old.outbox());out.add(receipt);
            Data update=new Data(next,receipt.version(),Map.copyOf(history),List.copyOf(out));
            if(current.compareAndSet(old,update))return Optional.of(receipt);
        }
    }
    /** 只有下游已幂等确认才 ack；发送成功后 ack 前崩溃仍会重送。 */
    public void acknowledge(String id){Objects.requireNonNull(id);for(;;){Data old=current.get();List<Receipt> next=old.outbox().stream().filter(x->!x.id().equals(id)).toList();if(next.size()==old.outbox().size())return;
        if(current.compareAndSet(old,new Data(old.state(),old.version(),old.receipts(),next)))return;
    }}
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        Map<Edge,String> graph=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<49;i++)graph.put(new Edge("S"+i,"next"),"S"+(i+1));
        WorkflowFsm f=new WorkflowFsm("S0",graph);try{f.apply(0,"bad","unknown");throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalStateException expected){}
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);CountDownLatch go=new CountDownLatch(1);
        try{Future<Optional<Receipt>>a=p.submit(()->{go.await();return f.apply(0,"a","next");});Future<Optional<Receipt>>b=p.submit(()->{go.await();return f.apply(0,"b","next");});go.countDown();
            Optional<Receipt>ra=a.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS),rb=b.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS);if(ra.isPresent()==rb.isPresent())throw new AssertionError("version collision");
            Receipt winner=ra.orElseGet(rb::orElseThrow);if(!f.apply(0,winner.id(),"next").orElseThrow().equals(winner)||f.version()!=1||f.outbox().size()!=1)throw new AssertionError("idempotency");
            try{f.apply(1,winner.id(),"other");throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
            // 模拟发送失败：不 ack，事件仍在；重复发送由接收方去重，确认后才移除。
            Set<String>delivered=new HashSet<>();for(int retry=0;retry<2;retry++)for(Receipt r:f.outbox())delivered.add(r.id());if(delivered.size()!=1)throw new AssertionError();f.acknowledge(winner.id());
            if(!f.outbox().isEmpty() || f.version()!=1)throw new AssertionError("ack changed business state");
            for(int i=1;i<49;i++)if(f.apply(i,"event"+i,"next").isEmpty())throw new AssertionError();
            if(!f.state().equals("S49") || f.version()!=49 || f.outbox().size()!=48)throw new AssertionError("50 states");
            try{f.apply(49,"end","next");throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalStateException expected){}
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("WorkflowFsm PASS: 50 states/49 sparse edges, illegal edge, one concurrent version winner, idempotency, atomic outbox/ack");
    }
}

entries.title: 购券预留、支付结果未知与重试
entries.questionHtml: AI Coding 优惠券分发系统 — AI Coding：高并发分人群分发优惠券系统（继承架构、边界测试、README）（淘天）
entries.analysisHtml: 明确演示假设：每个订单购买一张券，固定正整数分价格，不做浮点金额；可信认证适配器提供Principal，buyer必须匹配，资格来自可信segment；本代码不实现登录。稳定key绑定buyer/金额；同key重复不会重复预留。内存订单有RESERVED/UNKNOWN/CONFIRMED/REJECTED。库存与预留订单同锁提交，网关在锁外调用。
entries.answerHtml:
优惠券分人群分发/购买：自包含参考合同与失败矩阵

先说清题目约定

明确演示假设：每个订单购买一张券，固定正整数分价格，不做浮点金额；可信认证适配器提供Principal，buyer必须匹配，资格来自可信segment；本代码不实现登录。稳定key绑定buyer/金额；同key重复不会重复预留。内存订单有RESERVED/UNKNOWN/CONFIRMED/REJECTED。库存与预留订单同锁提交，网关在锁外调用。

为什么这样写是正确的

扣库存和创建订单在一个临界区，终态检查和返库也在一个临界区，明确失败最多补偿一次。网络异常或提交未知必须保留预留并标UNKNOWN，通过同key重试/查询收敛，绝不能把超时当失败返库。并发同key可重复调用网关，因此假设网关按key幂等且终态稳定；本地锁不能代替外部这个能力。

时间和空间成本

本地HashMap操作期望O(1)，订单历史O(requests)，资格集查询期望O(1)；单全局锁适于说明一致性，不宣称压测吞吐。外部I/O耗时不在常数复杂度承诺内，调用方需独立超时与取消策略。

怎样验证边界

100调用竞争库存10无超卖，30并发重复key只预留一次，提交未知不返库、重试确认，明确订单失败只补偿一次；身份不匹配、资格拒绝、负数/零/错价/Long.MAX_VALUE金额、同key不同买家均拒绝。

哪些条件需要另行处理

没有真实扣款或外部服务调用。未知状态对账、持久数据库事务、服务重启、多模板/多实例、退款、真实授权与原继承结构仍是生产接入任务，mock 通过只证明当前内存模型的行为，不证明生产接入正确。

CouponReference.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** 单 JVM 内存参考工程；所有网关调用在锁外；真实鉴权、持久事务与原仓库均未提供。 */
public final class CouponReference {
    public record Principal(String user,Set<String> segments){public Principal{Objects.requireNonNull(user);segments=Set.copyOf(segments);}}
    public enum Status { RESERVED, UNKNOWN, CONFIRMED, REJECTED }
    public enum GatewayResult { SUCCESS, DEFINITIVE_FAILURE, UNKNOWN }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface Gateway { GatewayResult purchase(String idempotencyKey,String buyer,long cents)throws Exception; }
    public record Order(String key,String buyer,long cents,Status status){}
    /** 接口边界替代未知原工程继承树；只有实际拿到工程才能保证继承原架构。 */
    public interface Eligibility { boolean allowed(Principal principal); }
    public static final class SegmentEligibility implements Eligibility {
        private final String segment;public SegmentEligibility(String segment){this.segment=Objects.requireNonNull(segment);}
        public boolean allowed(Principal p){return p.segments().contains(segment);}
    }
    private final Eligibility policy;private final long price;private int available;private final Map<String,Order> orders=new HashMap<>();
    public CouponReference(int stock,long price,Eligibility policy){if(stock<0 || price<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();this.available=stock;this.price=price;this.policy=Objects.requireNonNull(policy);}
    public synchronized int available(){return available;}
    public Order purchase(Principal principal,String buyer,String key,long cents,Gateway gateway)throws Exception{
        Objects.requireNonNull(principal);Objects.requireNonNull(buyer);Objects.requireNonNull(key);Objects.requireNonNull(gateway);
        if(key.isBlank() || !principal.user().equals(buyer))throw new SecurityException("buyer mismatch");
        if(!policy.allowed(principal))throw new SecurityException("segment denied");
        if(cents<=0 || cents!=price)throw new IllegalArgumentException("exact template price in cents");
        synchronized(this){Order prior=orders.get(key);
            if(prior!=null){if(!prior.buyer().equals(buyer)||prior.cents()!=cents)throw new IllegalArgumentException("idempotency payload mismatch");if(prior.status()==Status.CONFIRMED || prior.status()==Status.REJECTED)return prior;}
            else{if(available==0)throw new IllegalStateException("sold out");available--;orders.put(key,new Order(key,buyer,cents,Status.RESERVED));}
        }
        GatewayResult result;
        try{result=Objects.requireNonNull(gateway.purchase(key,buyer,cents));}
        catch(InterruptedException e){mark(key,GatewayResult.UNKNOWN);throw e;}
        catch(Exception e){return mark(key,GatewayResult.UNKNOWN);} // 超时/异常是未知，不能擅自返库。
        return mark(key,result);
    }
    private synchronized Order mark(String key,GatewayResult result){Order prior=orders.get(key);
        if(prior.status()==Status.CONFIRMED || prior.status()==Status.REJECTED)return prior;
        Status next=switch(result){case SUCCESS->Status.CONFIRMED;case DEFINITIVE_FAILURE->Status.REJECTED;case UNKNOWN->Status.UNKNOWN;};
        if(next==Status.REJECTED)available++;Order updated=new Order(key,prior.buyer(),prior.cents(),next);orders.put(key,updated);return updated;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        Eligibility segment=new SegmentEligibility("eligible");Principal p=new Principal("alice",Set.of("eligible"));CouponReference c=new CouponReference(10,100,segment);
        // fake 网关遵守同 key 最终状态稳定、重复调用不重复扣款的前置契约。
        ConcurrentHashMap<String,GatewayResult> payments=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();Gateway success=(key,buyer,price)->payments.computeIfAbsent(key,k->GatewayResult.SUCCESS);
        ExecutorService pool=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        try{List<Future<Boolean>>fs=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<100;i++){String key="order"+i;fs.add(pool.submit(()->{try{return c.purchase(p,"alice",key,100,success).status()==Status.CONFIRMED;}catch(IllegalStateException soldOut){return false;}}));}
            int issued=0;for(Future<Boolean> f:fs)if(f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))issued++;if(issued!=10 || c.available()!=0 || payments.size()!=10)throw new AssertionError("oversell");
            CouponReference duplicate=new CouponReference(1,100,segment);fs.clear();for(int i=0;i<30;i++)fs.add(pool.submit(()->duplicate.purchase(p,"alice","same",100,success).status()==Status.CONFIRMED));for(Future<Boolean>f:fs)if(!f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError();if(duplicate.available()!=0)throw new AssertionError("duplicate reservation");
            CouponReference uncertain=new CouponReference(1,100,segment);Order unknown=uncertain.purchase(p,"alice","unknown",100,(k,b,v)->{throw new TimeoutException("commit may have happened");});
            if(unknown.status()!=Status.UNKNOWN || uncertain.available()!=0)throw new AssertionError("unsafe compensation");
            if(uncertain.purchase(p,"alice","unknown",100,success).status()!=Status.CONFIRMED || uncertain.available()!=0)throw new AssertionError("reconcile retry");
            CouponReference failed=new CouponReference(1,100,segment);Gateway deny=(k,b,v)->GatewayResult.DEFINITIVE_FAILURE;
            failed.purchase(p,"alice","fail",100,deny);failed.purchase(p,"alice","fail",100,deny);if(failed.available()!=1)throw new AssertionError("double compensation");
            try{failed.purchase(p,"bob","auth",100,success);throw new AssertionError();}catch(SecurityException expected){}
            try{failed.purchase(new Principal("alice",Set.of()),"alice","segment",100,success);throw new AssertionError();}catch(SecurityException expected){}
            for(long bad:new long[]{-1,0,99,Long.MAX_VALUE})try{failed.purchase(p,"alice","price",bad,success);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
            try{failed.purchase(new Principal("bob",Set.of("eligible")),"bob","fail",100,success);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
        }finally{pool.shutdownNow();if(!pool.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("CouponReference PASS: stock10/100 callers, concurrent idempotency, unknown/retry, definitive-failure compensation once, principal/segment/amount boundaries");
    }
}

entries.answerHtml:
转账锁顺序：补测基线实现的并发守恒与错误原子性

先说清题目约定

仅内存模拟，正负参数与同对象规则遵循基线：负金额拒绝、同对象直接成功、不同对象同id拒绝；余额不足false。interruptible获取两个锁，已持有锁用finally释放。

为什么这样写是正确的

双向转账仍按同一个全序获取锁，不能形成反向等待环；接收方Math.addExact在扣除发送方前执行，所以溢出不会产生半笔转账。此处守恒检查在所有Future结束后读两个余额，避免把跨时点读误判为不守恒。

时间和空间成本

每次固定两个账户O(1)运算/状态，等待受竞争影响；不提供跨数据库或真实支付的事务担保。

怎样验证边界

8线程共8000次双向转账有界完成，总额20000、余额非负；不足、同对象、重复id、负金额、接收余额溢出保持原余额。

哪些条件需要另行处理

测试针对 DeadlockExamples 的双账户锁实现。没有真实金融账户或转账。

TransferContractTest.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** 测试原有账户代码，不修改或宣称数据库事务/真实支付已验证。 */
public final class TransferContractTest {
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        DeadlockExamples.Account a=new DeadlockExamples.Account(1,10000),b=new DeadlockExamples.Account(2,10000);
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);CountDownLatch start=new CountDownLatch(1);
        try{List<Future<?>>fs=new ArrayList<>();for(int k=0;k<8;k++){boolean forward=k%2==0;fs.add(p.submit(()->{start.await();for(int i=0;i<1000;i++)DeadlockExamples.transfer(forward?a:b,forward?b:a,1);return null;}));}
            start.countDown();for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(4,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(a.balance()+b.balance()!=20000 || a.balance()<0 || b.balance()<0)throw new AssertionError("conservation");
            if(DeadlockExamples.transfer(a,b,30000))throw new AssertionError("overdraw");
            if(!DeadlockExamples.transfer(a,a,1))throw new AssertionError("self");
            try{DeadlockExamples.transfer(a,new DeadlockExamples.Account(1,0),1);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
            try{DeadlockExamples.transfer(a,b,-1);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalArgumentException expected){}
            DeadlockExamples.Account full=new DeadlockExamples.Account(3,Long.MAX_VALUE);long before=a.balance();
            try{DeadlockExamples.transfer(a,full,1);throw new AssertionError();}catch(ArithmeticException expected){}
            if(a.balance()!=before || full.balance()!=Long.MAX_VALUE)throw new AssertionError("partial overflow debit");
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("TransferContractTest PASS: 8000 opposing transfers, conservation, nonnegative, insufficient, self, duplicate ID, negative, overflow");
    }
}
